items.docs:
Upload and store a WebRTC dump file or a rtcstats file to your account using a chunked flow.

The API works in two steps:
  • - First upload chunks via multipart/form-data
  • - Then assemble via application/json
The API consumes one credit if successful.

params.name: save
params.description: When true or 1, store the file in the account in addition to returning the analysis JSON.

items.docs:
Upload a webrtc-internal file or a rtcstats file, process it and return summary, observations and scores. By default the session is not stored: pass query save=true (or save=1) to also persist the dump like /upload.

Send the dump the same way as /upload: upload the file in chunks, then send a small JSON assemble request.

This API consumes one credit if successful.

For a rtcstats-server or any server that only needs the observations and scores projection. Processes a webrtc-internal file or a rtcstats file and returns just that projection: experience, audio, video, connectivity and observations scores, per-severity observation counts, flat trimmed observation records, and the user-agent data. The session is never stored.

Send the dump the same way as /upload: upload the file in chunks, then send a small JSON assemble request.

Model Context Protocol Streamable HTTP transport.
Use an MCP client with this URL.
Send Authorization: Bearer with your application JWT on requests that invoke tools.
Exposes tools:
  • - get_quota
  • - list_sessions
  • - get_session
Returns total allowed credits and remaining credits for the account. Include the purchased credits.
Returns the list of observations the analyzer can emit.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter sessions whose title contains ANY of these substrings

params.name: observationTypes
params.description: Filter sessions that contain ANY of these observation type strings (exact type name, e.g. `turnNoConfig`). Comma-separated. Only critical/high/medium observations are indexed (low/info are excluded). The full catalog of types is available from GET /v1.0/observations. Up to 20 values.

params.name: observationTags
params.description: Filter sessions whose observations carry ANY of these tags. Comma-separated. Valid tags: `connectivity`, `security`, `audio`, `video`, `datachannel`, `outbound`, `inbound`, `peripheral`, `behavior`, `network`, `configuration`, `cpu`, `bug`.

params.name: os
params.description: Filter sessions by operating system (exact match). Examples: `macOS`, `Windows`, `Linux`, `Android`, `iPhone`, `iPad`.

params.name: browser
params.description: Filter sessions by browser (exact match). Examples: `Chrome`, `Safari`, `Firefox`, `Edge`.

params.name: browserVersion
params.description: Filter sessions by major browser version (exact match, e.g. `142`).

params.name: userId
params.description: Filter sessions by the end-user identifier carried in the rtcstats JWT (summary metadata user).

params.name: conferenceId
params.description: Filter sessions by the conference identifier carried in the rtcstats JWT (summary metadata conference).

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Filter sessions by the session identifier carried in the rtcstats JWT (summary metadata session).

params.name: hasCritical
params.description: When `true`, only sessions with at least one critical-severity observation.

params.name: hasHigh
params.description: When `true`, only sessions with at least one high-severity observation.

params.name: hasMedium
params.description: When `true`, only sessions with at least one medium-severity observation.

params.name: hasLowScore
params.description: When `true`, only sessions whose experience score is low (`< 60`).

params.name: hasMediumScore
params.description: When `true`, only sessions whose experience score is medium (`60` to `79`).

params.name: hasHighScore
params.description: When `true`, only sessions whose experience score is high (`>= 80`).
